g.text: private repo through a pull request
Prompt injection in a PR title makes
a coding agent post its secrets
Hidden HTML comment on a docs page
exfiltrates an API key via a URL
A phishing email tells the assistant
A server you approved changes its
an instruction in a blog post
A plain-looking note tricks the agent
Read local notes and write a summary
Send an email the user dictated
Read a repo file and open a pull
Research a page and save notes
Read docs, then edit my own code with
Email myself one of my notes
